tour.cryptoNetwork.presets.title: Presets
tour.cryptoNetwork.presets.body: Ready public nodes of this network. Press one to fill the field, then check the connection.
tour.cryptoNetwork.wipeBackup.title: Backup first
tour.cryptoNetwork.wipeBackup.body: Make a copy of the vault here. Without a fresh copy the wipe does not start.
whatsNew.cryptoEngine.title: Crypto: following a public address
whatsNew.cryptoEngine.follow: Wallets → Connect an address: the engine reads the address on its own and keeps its assets and operations up to date. Nothing is typed in by hand.
whatsNew.cryptoEngine.tokens: Unknown tokens that arrive on their own wait in quarantine: press Recognise to count one, or hide it. A token's current price comes from the app's usual price sources; the price at the time of a past operation comes from DeFiLlama, asked by token and date, and the address is never sent.
whatsNew.cryptoBybit.title: Bybit now runs on the engine
whatsNew.cryptoBybit.moved: The Bybit connection is read by the same engine as the addresses. Your old Bybit imports were converted once, the cost basis stays.
whatsNew.cryptoBybit.queue: The queue of trades to check is gone: new trades land in the operations of the wallet by themselves.
whatsNew.cryptoWipe.title: Crypto: wiping the module
whatsNew.cryptoWipe.backup: Settings → Crypto → Wiping removes the whole crypto module from the vault. A copy of the vault is made and checked first; without it nothing is deleted.
whatsNew.cryptoWipe.wallets: No wallet is deleted: each goes to the archive with its history, and the keys of this device are removed.
whatsNew.cryptoManualEnd.title: The end of hand-made crypto records
whatsNew.cryptoManualEnd.forms: The old forms for spot, futures and DeFi records are gone: crypto now comes from a connected address or exchange.
whatsNew.cryptoManualEnd.readable: Records you made by hand stay in the vault and stay readable, in the archive.
